FontAwesome

NineSliceSprite

A osu.Framework.Graphics.Sprites.Sprite that uses 9-slice scaling to stretch a Texture. When resizing a osu.Framework.Graphics.Sprites.NineSliceSprite, the corners will remain unscaled.

A                          B

+---+----------------------+---+ C | 1 | 2 | 3 | +---+----------------------+---+ | | | | | 4 | 5 | 6 | | | | | +---+----------------------+---+ D | 7 | 8 | 9 | +---+----------------------+---+

When changing the osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.Width, areas 1, 4, 7, 3, 6, and 9 (A and B) will remain unscaled. When changing the osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.Height, areas 1, 2, 3, 7, 8, and 9 (C and D) will remain unscaled.
